_description: Boot-time reminders registry. Any agent appends entries. Boot reads and surfaces them. Entries self-remove on successful acknowledgment.
_instructions: Append new entries to the reminders array using the add-reminder skill. Never manually edit ids. Boot surfaces entries where trigger_date <= today. On yes: execute action_prompt via routing.agent, then remove the entry. On no: advance trigger_date by snooze_days.

reminders.trigger_prompt: Ready to revisit the AI Practice 2027 build plan and settle the five open decisions for Curtis before the one-page charter has to go to the Dec 1-2 session?

routing.action_prompt: David confirmed he is ready to revisit the AI Practice 2027 build plan now that it has had time to breathe. This is a working review with David. Do not rewrite the plan unless he asks. SOURCE DOCUMENT (read it in full first): /Users/davidohara/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-Improving/IES/reference/ai-practice-2027-plan.md (about 27KB). Structure: Phase 1 landscape, Phase 2 diagnosis/crux/bad-strategy scan, Phase 3 kernel (guiding policy plus coherent actions A1 through A6), quarter-by-quarter shape, Phase 4 create-destroy, Phase 5 two-minute action agenda, then 'Questions David has to answer before this goes to Curtis' at lines 146 to 153. The kernel in one line: a small central hub (David, pre-sales, a delivery architect, an enablement lead) owns the offer portfolio, delivery kits, pre-sales motion, bench development, and the revenue scoreboard; the presidents (spokes) own client relationships, pursuit priority, and delivery staffing. The one-page charter (action A1, plan lines 80 to 88) is ratified at the Dec 1-2 president-group 2027 strategy session and signed by Curtis and every president by Dec 15 (the Rock 5 date). Do these four things in order. (1) RE-IMMERSE: give David a short brief of at most 200 words covering the crux, the guiding policy, the six coherent actions, and the two most likely causes of death (the federation collapsing into the matrix trap, and commercial success that quietly skips the bench). Do not re-derive the strategy. It is already built and this is a revisit, not a rebuild. (2) FIVE OPEN DECISIONS, one at a time, in this order, each with the plan's own framing, your recommendation, and a place to record his answer: [D1] Revenue number. What first-year direct revenue range is defensible when he sits down with Curtis? Plan says bring a range, not a request; the defensible shape is POC-scale early plays compounding into production phases. Recommend a low, target, and stretch number. [D2] Protected allocation percentage. A company at 12 percent MTD in October giving up bench time is the hardest ask in the plan. What percentage, and what does each president get back for it (enablement product for their clients, first access to the catalog, influenced-revenue credit)? The plan's own rule: if David cannot answer what the spoke gets, the charter does not go to the Dec 1-2 session. Do not let this one slide. [D3] Pre-sales person. Internal conversion versus external hire. The plan leans internal. The decision is a name, or the plan has a hole shaped like a person. Push for a name or a named shortlist with a decision date. [D4] Scope. All of Improving, or Texas-first and federation-second in year 1? If non-Texas offices are in scope, their presidents' signatures are needed and they may not be in the Dec 1-2 room. [D5] What David personally stops doing. The 2027 calendar cannot carry South Texas recovery, the Solace plays, the platform, and practice leadership at delivery distance. Something gets delegated. Name it. Record each answer. If David defers one, write it down as an explicit open item with a date, never as settled. (3) DRAFT THE ONE-PAGE CHARTER for the Dec 1-2 session per action A1 in the plan (lines 80 to 88). It must cover, on one page per element: the hub/spoke ownership split; the exclusions (no central client ownership, no own client P&L, no product or IP bets in year 1, no undefined calendar expansion for David); the revenue definitions (direct versus influenced, with the attribution rules: named in the deal record by the selling president, AI activity documented pre-close, capped contribution percentages by role type, unattributed AI-adjacent revenue counts zero); and the decider rules, including the two cases the plan names explicitly: a president wants an AI proposal the bench cannot staff (pre-sales proposes the catalog only, new capabilities route to David for a lighthouse ruling), and the hub wants a client intro a president will not give (it goes on the president-group agenda, never around them). Fold in whatever David decided in step 2. Show him the draft in chat first. Write it to a file only after he approves it, at /Users/davidohara/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-Improving/IES/reference/ai-practice-2027-charter.md, and note in that file that it is a draft for the Dec 1-2 session, not a signed document. (4) REPORT BACK: the five decisions with David's answers or explicit open items, a list of what is still missing before the charter can be signed by Dec 15, and whether the Dec 1-2 session still looks like a realistic ratification moment. If any of the five is unresolved, say so plainly as the headline. Constraints: no em-dashes anywhere in the charter or the report. Do not edit the source plan unless David asks for a specific change. Offer, do not assume, a working-memory note in /Users/davidohara/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-Improving/IES/memory/working/ for the decision log.

on_no.message: Understood. I will raise it again tomorrow, which is the Friday deadline you set.

routing.action_prompt:
HARD HOLD FIRST. Plaud recording file_id 900d3853c0a06d570942db021be3853d ("11-03 Meeting: Extension Incentives and AI SOW Eligibility") carries a temporary test label "Speaker 1 TEST" on 22 segments, left over from the Phase 3c v3 write-path test run on 2026-11-03 at about 11:55 CT. Knox / workflows/plaud-ingest must NOT ingest it while that label is present. If a plaud-ingest run has already started or starts before this completes, the recording must be excluded from the ingest set (workflow state lives at /Users/davidohara/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-Improving/IES/workflows/plaud-ingest/state.yaml). Read /Users/davidohara/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-Improving/IES/memory/working/2026-11-03-115656-rigby-plaud-v3-write-path-proven.md and /Users/davidohara/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-Improving/IES/reference/plaud-v4-rewrite-plan.md before touching anything.

STEP 1, TIMING CHECK. The 24h durability gate is due 2026-11-04 at about 11:55 CT, 24 hours after the test write. If the current time is before that window, say so plainly and do not run the gate early. Do not fake or infer durability. Re-check in the same day or tell David when you will return.

STEP 2, DURABILITY GATE. Re-read all three stores for 900d3853 and confirm whether "Speaker 1 TEST" survived 24 hours: (a) legacy trans_result via the file detail read (GET /file/detail/{id} on the existing account token), (b) the transaction_polish source in /ai/update_source_info data, and (c) the web UI rendering after a full page reload. Also force an app refresh by reloading the Plaud web app session before reading, so a cached view cannot pass the gate. Expect 22 of 22 segments labeled "Speaker 1 TEST" in each store. Record exact counts per store.

STEP 3A, IF THE LABEL DID NOT PERSIST. If the 4.0 pipeline rebuilt the transcript and the label is gone or partially gone, do NOT re-apply it. The test is failed or inconclusive; record precisely what each store shows and stop at reporting. The recording is still blocked from ingest until the transcript is clean of the string "TEST".

STEP 3B, IF THE LABEL PERSISTED. Revert "Speaker 1 TEST" back to "Speaker 1" on all 22 segments using the committed v3 two-write sequence, in this order: (1) PATCH /file/{id} with {"trans_result": <full corrected trans_result>, "support_mul_summ": true}; (2) POST /ai/update_source_info with {file_id, source_id: <transaction_polish full data_id>, source_type: "transaction_polish", source_content: JSON.stringify(trans_result)}. The second call is mandatory: PATCH alone leaves the 4.0 pipeline free to rebuild from its own polish source. Use the existing account token; the private v4 file-app route is unavailable for this account and must not be pursued.

STEP 4, VERIFY THE REVERT. After writing, reload and re-read all three stores plus the web UI. Require 0 of 22 segments containing "TEST" and 22 of 22 reading "Speaker 1". Capture file_version before and after. A pre-change backup exists at /Users/davidohara/Downloads/transcript-staging/plaud_3c-single-rename_v3-backup-20261103T115453.json if a rollback reference is needed; do not overwrite it.

STEP 5, CLEAR OR KEEP THE BLOCK. Only if step 4 is fully clean, mark the recording cleared for Knox / plaud-ingest. If any store still shows "TEST", keep the block and say so as the headline of your report.

REPORT BACK: the gate result per store (segments labeled TEST out of 22 for legacy trans_result, polish source, web UI), whether the revert ran, segments changed, file_version before and after, remaining "TEST" occurrences anywhere, and one explicit line stating whether recording 900d3853 is cleared for ingest or still blocked and why. Constraints: no em-dashes in anything you write. Do not ingest the recording yourself; that is Knox's job in workflows/plaud-ingest.
